_comment: Copy to data/accessories.json. The residue of a STRIPPED bike, which the main sweep drops on purpose. Ranked by SELLER, not by item: one account selling a child seat, a rack and a pannier in the same fortnight is a bike that came apart. locked_categories are the parts your coded skewers hold on -- a seller offering those AS WELL AS unlocked kit implies an angle grinder, i.e. a chop shop rather than an opportunist. locks_national maps a lock brand -> needs_bike_context, because 'pinhead' is also a Hellraiser figure and the first test pass pushed one. Set the ones you actually own. signature_categories are the parts that came off YOUR bike with an allen key; clusters rank on how many of those a seller has.
